narrative: Hawkish internal division at the Fed anchors the weekend tape as markets brace for Friday's US labor data, likely supporting the USD at the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1527, facing downside risk as the +146bp OIS carry advantage favors the USD, while GBP/USD closed at 1.3487 with buyers testing technical resistance. JPY outperformance (1W avg: +2.986%) and the BoJ's recent hike hint would pressure USD/JPY from its Friday close of 157.4 should intervention fears persist through the Sunday open.
